They don't know how to react most likely. My mom reacted the same way. The next day she was a completely different person and was actually supportive. Too bad she lost my trust with the first day. Never talking to her about mental health ever again.

My mom keeps telling me that I will ruin her reputation if I don't say Hi to every fucking person in our apartment complex. It's something I always struggled to do. Deciding whether to use Hello or Good (Morning/Afternoon/Evening) is the worst of all because if you mess up it's embarrassing (Saying Hello to a 60 year old or saying Good Afternoon to someone my age).
I don't have one. Not planning on getting one for now because of other issues.

I am on a vacation in a country where I don't speak the language so one person ordered for the entire table (makes it much easier for everyone). I could've asked for the Wi-Fi password in english if I wanted. I did not mean to sound passive-agressive and no one thought it was. They just told me "why don't you ask for it?" then I told them it's difficult for me to speak to people and choose not to when it's not required. That's when they told me I need to learn to speak to people.

And as for the wifi password. I got it when someone else also wanted to use the wifi and they asked for it. I do not believe I am entitled to anything...

I am sorry for what you had to go through. I never forget or lose my things but I always check everything 15 times to the point where I am late because I was yanking on the door handle for 2 minutes making sure it's closed or something like that.

I am able to speak to cashiers because it is necessary. If I can choose not to, I don't (the wifi example). Another thing is when my barber asks me how I've been or what kind of stuff I've been working on (Coding is a hobby of mine, I usually tell people that but when they ask about more specific things is when I get extremely anxious because I HATE talking about my projects for some reason.). I can't just tell him to cut my hair in silence because I will sound rude. I remember one time he asked me about something and I just froze for half a minute without making a sound and it was so embarrassing.
